import collections, concurrent.futures, hashlib, itertools, json, subprocess, sys, types
from pathlib import Path

REPO = Path.cwd().resolve()
EXPECTED_REPO = Path("/Users/kelvin/VibeCoding-WorkSpace/MathStatisticalAnalysis").resolve()
assert REPO == EXPECTED_REPO, (REPO, EXPECTED_REPO)
PILOT_COMMIT = "445c09678cfaa1438786fed4e8e88a1981eff366"
PILOT_PATH = "docs/research/matrix-native-results/b649-k20-three-ticket-exact-repair-lns-pilot-r1-result.json"
ROOT_COMMIT = "3655b0f4bc43450748b4fc87c641d0acd11a8509"
ROOT_PATH = "docs/research/matrix-native-results/b649-k20-three-ticket-cycle-full-family-r1-result.json"
MODULE_COMMIT = "7d3ea86ca9cf167344391a29e0a10d4630292559"
MODULE_PATH = "src/lottolab/research/b649_k20_three_ticket_single_number_cycle_r1.py"
MODULE_SHA256 = "79799744151daa638dd7a8bd372563fcb310c76825efb493415688983a6d5649"
CANONICAL_PATH = "src/lottolab/research/b649_official_any_prize_exact.py"

def git_bytes(rev, path):
    return subprocess.check_output(["git", "show", f"{rev}:{path}"], cwd=REPO)

pilot_bytes = git_bytes(PILOT_COMMIT, PILOT_PATH)
pilot = json.loads(pilot_bytes)
root_bytes = git_bytes(ROOT_COMMIT, ROOT_PATH)
root_result = json.loads(root_bytes)
provenance = pilot["STARTS"]["three_ticket_cycle"]["PROVENANCE"]
root_blob = subprocess.check_output(
    ["git", "rev-parse", f"{ROOT_COMMIT}:{ROOT_PATH}"], cwd=REPO, text=True
).strip()
root_tree = subprocess.check_output(
    ["git", "rev-parse", f"{ROOT_COMMIT}^{{tree}}"], cwd=REPO, text=True
).strip()
assert root_blob == provenance["RESULT_BLOB"]
assert hashlib.sha256(root_bytes).hexdigest() == provenance["RESULT_FILE_SHA256"]
assert root_tree == provenance["RESULT_TREE"]

sys.path.insert(0, str(REPO / "src"))
module_bytes = git_bytes(MODULE_COMMIT, MODULE_PATH)
assert hashlib.sha256(module_bytes).hexdigest() == MODULE_SHA256
canonical_blob = subprocess.check_output(
    ["git", "rev-parse", f"{MODULE_COMMIT}:{CANONICAL_PATH}"], cwd=REPO, text=True
).strip()
head_canonical_blob = subprocess.check_output(
    ["git", "rev-parse", f"HEAD:{CANONICAL_PATH}"], cwd=REPO, text=True
).strip()
assert canonical_blob == head_canonical_blob, (canonical_blob, head_canonical_blob)
module_name = "lottolab.research.b649_k20_three_ticket_single_number_cycle_r1"
ttc = types.ModuleType(module_name)
ttc.__file__ = str(REPO / MODULE_PATH)
ttc.__package__ = "lottolab.research"
sys.modules[module_name] = ttc
exec(compile(module_bytes, ttc.__file__, "exec"), ttc.__dict__)

driver_source = root_result["DRIVER_SOURCE"]
assert hashlib.sha256(driver_source.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest() == root_result["DRIVER_SHA256"]
driver_ns = {"__name__": "_neutral_repair_escape_pinned_driver", "__file__": "<in-memory-pinned-driver>"}
exec(compile(driver_source, driver_ns["__file__"], "exec"), driver_ns)
assert callable(driver_ns["scan_triple"])

root_portfolio = ttc.normalize_portfolio(
    root_result["BEST_PORTFOLIO"], pool_size=49, expected_ticket_count=20
)
root_sha = ttc.portfolio_sha256(root_portfolio, pool_size=49)
root_count = pilot["BEST_FINAL_COUNT"]
assert root_sha == pilot["STARTS"]["three_ticket_cycle"]["PORTFOLIO_SHA256"]
assert root_count == pilot["STARTS"]["three_ticket_cycle"]["CANONICAL_COUNT"]
assert root_count == root_result["BEST_COUNT"]
assert root_result["BEST_CANONICAL_RECOUNT_STATUS"] == "PASS"

root_set = set(root_portfolio)
candidate_map = {}
equal_rows = 0
for index, row in enumerate(pilot["RECORDS"]):
    if (
        row.get("BEST_COUNT") == root_count
        and row.get("BEST_CANONICAL_COUNT") == root_count
        and row.get("BEST_CANONICAL_RECOUNT") == "PASS"
    ):
        equal_rows += 1
        dropped = {tuple(sorted(ticket)) for ticket in row["BEST_TICKETS_DROPPED"]}
        added = {tuple(sorted(ticket)) for ticket in row["BEST_TICKETS_ADDED"]}
        candidate = ttc.normalize_portfolio(
            (root_set - dropped) | added, pool_size=49, expected_ticket_count=20
        )
        digest = ttc.portfolio_sha256(candidate, pool_size=49)
        assert digest == row["BEST_SHA256"], (index, digest, row["BEST_SHA256"])
        entry = candidate_map.setdefault(
            digest, {"portfolio": candidate, "records": [], "canonical_count": row["BEST_CANONICAL_COUNT"]}
        )
        assert entry["portfolio"] == candidate
        entry["records"].append(index)

starts = []
for digest, entry in candidate_map.items():
    candidate_set = set(entry["portfolio"])
    symmetric_difference = len(root_set ^ candidate_set)
    assert symmetric_difference % 2 == 0
    starts.append({
        "sha256": digest,
        "portfolio": entry["portfolio"],
        "records": entry["records"],
        "canonical_count": entry["canonical_count"],
        "distance": symmetric_difference // 2,
        "symmetric_difference": symmetric_difference,
    })
starts.sort(key=lambda item: (-item["distance"], item["sha256"]))
selected = starts[:8]
assert len(selected) == min(8, len(starts))
assert equal_rows == 24 and len(starts) == 6
assert len({item["sha256"] for item in selected}) == len(selected)

def emit_preflight():
    print(json.dumps({
        "STATUS": "PREFLIGHT_PASS",
        "REPO": str(REPO),
        "PILOT_COMMIT": PILOT_COMMIT,
        "ROOT_COUNT": root_count,
        "ROOT_SHA256": root_sha,
        "EQUAL_CANONICAL_RECORDS": equal_rows,
        "NEUTRAL_STARTS_AVAILABLE": len(starts),
        "NEUTRAL_STARTS_SELECTED": len(selected),
        "CYCLE_MODULE_SHA256": MODULE_SHA256,
        "DRIVER_SHA256": root_result["DRIVER_SHA256"],
        "STARTS": [
            {
                "SHA256": item["sha256"],
                "RECORDS": item["records"],
                "DISTANCE_TICKET_REPLACEMENTS": item["distance"],
                "SYMMETRIC_DIFFERENCE": item["symmetric_difference"],
            }
            for item in selected
        ],
    }, sort_keys=True))
    return 0

def run_family(start_sha):
    matching = [item for item in selected if item["sha256"] == start_sha]
    if len(matching) != 1:
        raise ValueError(f"start SHA not in frozen selection: {start_sha}")
    frozen = matching[0]
    draws = ttc.load_draws(49)
    start = ttc.bind_start(
        frozen["portfolio"],
        pool_size=49,
        expected_sha256=frozen["sha256"],
        expected_outcome_count=root_count,
        draws=draws,
    )
    driver_ns["_STATE"]["draws"] = draws
    driver_ns["_STATE"]["start"] = start

    triples = list(itertools.combinations(range(len(start.portfolio)), 3))
    raw = legal = local_duplicates = cross_duplicates = scored = 0
    improvements = equal_to_root = rebind_mismatches = 0
    seen = set()
    order_digest = hashlib.sha256()
    best = None
    best_tie_count = 0
    per_triple = []
    scan_started = __import__("time").perf_counter()
    iterator = iter(triples)
    with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2, thread_name_prefix="cycle") as pool:
        pending = collections.deque()
        for _ in range(2):
            triple = next(iterator, None)
            if triple is not None:
                pending.append((triple, pool.submit(driver_ns["scan_triple"], triple)))
        done = 0
        while pending:
            expected_triple, future = pending.popleft()
            result = future.result()
            triple = tuple(result["INDICES"])
            if triple != expected_triple:
                raise AssertionError((triple, expected_triple))
            done += 1
            raw += result["RAW"]
            legal += result["LEGAL"]
            local_duplicates += result["LOCAL_DUPLICATES"]
            rebind_ok = result["REBIND_COUNT"] == start.outcome_count
            rebind_mismatches += not rebind_ok
            triple_unique = 0
            triple_best = None
            for digest, numbers, direction, count in result["ROWS"]:
                scored += 1
                if digest in seen:
                    cross_duplicates += 1
                    continue
                seen.add(digest)
                order_digest.update(digest.encode() + b"\n")
                triple_unique += 1
                improvements += count > root_count
                equal_to_root += count == root_count
                triple_best = count if triple_best is None else max(triple_best, count)
                if best is None or count > best[0]:
                    best = (count, digest, triple, numbers, direction)
                    best_tie_count = 1
                elif count == best[0]:
                    best_tie_count += 1
                    if digest < best[1]:
                        best = (count, digest, triple, numbers, direction)
            per_triple.append({
                "INDICES": list(triple),
                "RAW": result["RAW"],
                "LEGAL": result["LEGAL"],
                "UNIQUE_AFTER_CROSS_DEDUP": triple_unique,
                "BEST_COUNT": triple_best,
                "REBIND_MATCH": rebind_ok,
            })
            if done % 50 == 0 or done == len(triples):
                print(json.dumps({
                    "PROGRESS_TRIPLES": done,
                    "TRIPLES_TOTAL": len(triples),
                    "EXACT_CANDIDATES_SCORED": scored,
                    "BEST_RESIDUAL_COUNT": best[0] if best else None,
                }, sort_keys=True), flush=True)
            next_triple = next(iterator, None)
            if next_triple is not None:
                pending.append((next_triple, pool.submit(driver_ns["scan_triple"], next_triple)))

    scan_seconds = __import__("time").perf_counter() - scan_started
    if best is None:
        raise RuntimeError("cycle family scored no candidates")

    generator_raw = ttc.count_raw_cycle_specs(start.portfolio, pool_size=49)
    generator_legal = 0
    generator_seen = set()
    generator_digest = hashlib.sha256()
    for _index, emission in ttc.iter_emitted_cycles(start.portfolio, pool_size=49):
        generator_legal += 1
        if emission.sha256 not in generator_seen:
            generator_seen.add(emission.sha256)
            generator_digest.update(emission.sha256.encode() + b"\n")

    best_emission = ttc._emit_spec_normalized(
        start.portfolio,
        ttc.RawCycleSpec(best[2], best[3], best[4]),
        pool_size=49,
    )
    if best_emission is None or best_emission.sha256 != best[1]:
        raise RuntimeError("best candidate could not be re-emitted")
    best_canonical_count = ttc.official_any_prize_outcome_count(
        best_emission.portfolio, pool_size=49, draws=draws
    )
    triples_expected = list(itertools.combinations(range(20), 3))
    checks = {
        "TRIPLES_COMPLETE": len(per_triple) == 1140
        and [tuple(item["INDICES"]) for item in per_triple] == triples_expected,
        "RAW_EQUALS_EXPECTED": raw == ttc.K20_RAW_ATTEMPT_CAP == 492480,
        "RAW_EQUALS_GENERATOR": raw == generator_raw,
        "PER_TRIPLE_RAW_432": all(item["RAW"] == ttc.TRIPLE_RAW_ATTEMPTS == 432 for item in per_triple),
        "LEGAL_EQUALS_GENERATOR": legal == generator_legal,
        "UNIQUE_EQUALS_GENERATOR": len(seen) == len(generator_seen),
        "UNIQUE_ORDER_EQUALS_GENERATOR": order_digest.hexdigest() == generator_digest.hexdigest(),
        "LEGAL_EQUALS_UNIQUE_PLUS_DUPLICATES": legal == len(seen) + local_duplicates + cross_duplicates,
        "SCORED_EQUALS_LEGAL_MINUS_LOCAL_DUPLICATES": scored == legal - local_duplicates,
        "PER_TRIPLE_START_REBIND": rebind_mismatches == 0,
        "BEST_CANONICAL_RECOUNT": best_canonical_count == best[0],
    }
    complete = all(checks.values())
    output = {
        "TASK_ID": "B649_K20_NEUTRAL_REPAIR_RESTART_ESCAPE_R1",
        "START_SHA256": start.sha256,
        "START_CANONICAL_COUNT": start.outcome_count,
        "START_RECORDS": frozen["records"],
        "STRUCTURAL_DISTANCE_TICKET_REPLACEMENTS": frozen["distance"],
        "STRUCTURAL_DISTANCE_SYMMETRIC_DIFFERENCE": frozen["symmetric_difference"],
        "ROOT_COUNT": root_count,
        "ROOT_SHA256": root_sha,
        "ROOT_PORTFOLIO": [list(ticket) for ticket in root_portfolio],
        "START_PORTFOLIO": [list(ticket) for ticket in start.portfolio],
        "FULL_CYCLE_FAMILY_COMPLETED": complete,
        "TRIPLES_COMPLETED": len(per_triple),
        "TRIPLES_TOTAL": len(triples),
        "RAW_ATTEMPTS": raw,
        "LEGAL_CANDIDATES": legal,
        "CROSS_TRIPLE_DUPLICATES": cross_duplicates,
        "EXACT_CANDIDATES_SCORED": scored,
        "UNIQUE_CANDIDATES": len(seen),
        "STRICT_IMPROVEMENTS_VS_ROOT": improvements,
        "CANDIDATES_EQUAL_TO_ROOT": equal_to_root,
        "BEST_COUNT": best[0],
        "BEST_DELTA": best[0] - root_count,
        "BEST_SHA256": best[1],
        "BEST_CANONICAL_COUNT": best_canonical_count,
        "BEST_CANONICAL_RECOUNT_MATCH": best_canonical_count == best[0],
        "BEST_PORTFOLIO": [list(ticket) for ticket in best_emission.portfolio],
        "BEST_MOVE": {
            "TRIPLE_INDICES": list(best_emission.indices),
            "NUMBERS": list(best_emission.numbers),
            "DIRECTION": best_emission.direction,
            "REMOVED": [list(ticket) for ticket in best_emission.removed],
            "ADDED": [list(ticket) for ticket in best_emission.added],
        },
        "BEST_TIE_COUNT": best_tie_count,
        "WALL_SECONDS": round(scan_seconds, 3),
        "WORKER_THREADS": 2,
        "CHECKS": checks,
        "PROTECTED_LANE_3_TOUCHED": "NO",
    }
    print(json.dumps(output, sort_keys=True), flush=True)
    return 0 if complete else 1

if len(sys.argv) < 2 or sys.argv[1] == "--preflight":
    sys.exit(emit_preflight())
sys.exit(run_family(sys.argv[1]))
